items.name: dialog-drawer
items.title: Dialog Drawer
items.description: A responsive Dialog: a centered Dialog at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Dialog on Base UI or Radix: desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a drawer={{}} override typed on your Drawer.

items.name: sheet-drawer
items.title: Sheet Drawer
items.description: A responsive Sheet: a side Sheet at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Sheet on Base UI or Radix: desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a drawer={{}} override typed on your Drawer.

items.name: popover-drawer
items.title: Popover Drawer
items.description: A responsive Popover: an anchored Popover at desktop that becomes a swipeable Drawer below 768px. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Popover on Base UI or Radix: desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a drawer={{}} override typed on your Drawer.

items.name: tooltip-popover
items.title: Tooltip Popover
items.description: A responsive Tooltip: a hover Tooltip at desktop that becomes a tap-to-open Popover below 768px, because hover does not exist on touch. Drop-in replacement for the shadcn Tooltip on Base UI or Radix: desktop props 1:1 on the root and every part, plus a popover={{}} override typed on your Popover.
